name: tone-capture-doctor
description: Local-first signal health and tone comparison tools for guitar and bass players.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/glossary && npm run typecheck --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/analysis-rules && npm run typecheck --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/audio-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/glossary && npm run test --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/analysis-rules && npm run test --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/audio-core && npm run test --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/web
scripts.test:e2e:pwa: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:pwa --workspace @tone-capture-doctor/web
